title: Integration Analyst
description: Join us as we work to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all. Strong communication skills and an ability to effectively engage with members of geographically disparate teams in India and the US. Creative and inquisitive demeanor. Open to working during U.S. business hours (5:30 PM–2:30 AM IST) Preferred Skills Healthcare domain knowledge and knowledge on Interfaces and Interface Engines Knowledge of HL7 standards Knowledge of patient safety and HIPAA Clinical Experience EMR specific Certification SQL Knowledge. Job Description: Job Description – Analyst – IT Risk and Compliance Key Responsibilities Assists with planning and execution of information technology SOX assessments by understanding organizational objectives, processes, policies, internal controls, and applicable regulatory requirements. Supports risk and control assessments by identifying potential areas of non-compliance, process weaknesses, control gaps, and opportunities for improvement. Performs compliance testing under established procedures and guidance, including documenting testing performed, results, exceptions, and supporting evidence. Tests IT General Controls (ITGCs) covering logical access, change management, computer operations, and system development/change lifecycle. Performs SAP ITGC/SOX control testing , particularly across logical access, privileged access, change management, and IT operations. Supports testing of IT Automated Controls (ITACs) and application controls supporting key business processes such as Payroll, Inventory, Revenue, and Financial Reporting. Prepares clear and complete compliance assessment workpapers, testing documentation, and supporting evidence in accordance with established standards. Participates in walkthroughs with business and IT stakeholders to understand applications, infrastructure, business processes, risks, and controls. Documents processes, risks, and controls through narratives, flowcharts, control matrices, and other supporting documentation. Supports evaluation of new or changed processes, systems, and controls to determine their potential impact on the SOX compliance program . Assists in identifying control deficiencies and supporting root-cause analysis and remediation activities. Tracks and follows up on IT audit and compliance findings to ensure remediation activities are completed within agreed timelines. Supports external and internal auditors by coordinating documentation, evidence, walkthroughs, and other information requests. Communicates testing progress, observations, and identified issues to the Internal Audit Team and relevant stakeholders. Obtains, analyzes, and evaluates technical and business documentation, reports, system-generated data, process flows, and supporting evidence. Maintains confidentiality of organizational and compliance-related information. Continues to develop knowledge of IT controls, SOX requirements, cybersecurity, business processes, emerging technologies, and industry practices. Contributes to team objectives and supports other compliance activities and improvement initiatives as required. Qualifications: Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Information Systems, Cybersecurity , or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience. 3 to 7 years of relevant experience in IT audit, Risk Management, SOX Compliance, ITGCs, technology risk, internal controls, or related fields. Previous experience with a Big 4 or similar audit/consulting environment is preferred but not mandatory . Working knowledge of Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) requirements and IT control concepts. description: Use Your Power for Purpose At Pfizer, technology impacts everything we do. You can grow into a Senior Manager technical lead role without moving into people management. Learn the work through regular calls, screen-share walkthroughs, and process reviews, map the process, and find where AI removes effort, risk, or delay. Run discovery with business users and process owners across regions, including the US and Europe. Translate business pain points into scoped use cases with success measures agreed with the business owner. Work from Product Owner priorities and specifications, and shape them into buildable scope with the business owner. Push back when the request doesn’t match the underlying problem or it’s exposed to technical issues and limitation. Build & Ship Build agentic AI solutions end to end: agents and tools on Azure AI Foundry, Vertex AI, other market leading runtimes and Microsoft Agent Framework, Lang Graph, LangChain, MCP tool integrations, retrieval with Azure AI Search, document extraction with Document Intelligence, and the interfaces users touch. Deliver working prototypes in days and MVPs in weeks. Iterate directly with end users. Write production-quality code in Python and TypeScript/JavaScript, with tests, version control, and code review. Use AI coding agents in your daily workflow, and review AI-generated code to the same standard as your own. Build evaluation sets that prove accuracy on real finance data before release, and run them as regression tests on every change. Data & Enterprise Integration Connect solutions to enterprise Finance and GBS data and systems through governed MCP tools (or API) and certified data products, such as SAP S/4HANA, Snowflake (including Cortex), Databricks, SAP Ariba and Business Network, Oracle EPM, Microsoft 365, and other enterprise platforms. Write and tune SQL. Use and extend the shared F&GBS ontology, semantic views, and business rules instead of hard-coding logic in prompts. Follow data access, entitlement, and classification rules for financial and personal data. Controls, Compliance & Responsible AI Design solutions that hold up to SOX, Internal Audit, data privacy (GDPR, India DPDP Act), and EU AI Act review. Record agent evidence, approvals, and actions in the decision ledger, and build human review steps where AI outputs drive financial decisions. Apply Pfizer responsible AI safeguards: data access controls, prompt injection defenses, and output monitoring. Document design decisions, data lineage, and model behavior for control owners. Production & Handoff Own production readiness and ongoing support: LLMOps practice, deployment pipelines, monitoring, incident response, and run costs. Establish support ownership, runbooks, service expectations, escalation paths, knowledge transfer, and root cause analysis for production solutions. Deploy through approved pipelines on Pfizer cloud and GenAI platforms. Set up logging, tracing, monitoring, and alerting with Azure Monitor, Application Insights, and Foundry Observability. Contribute reusable components and patterns to the team’s shared library. Value & Adoption Track usage, accuracy, and hours saved. Report results to the business owner and FDE leadership. Train users and build champions in the business so adoption sticks. BASIC QUALIFICATIONS You can partner with the business, turn messy problems into working solutions, and show the impact in numbers. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related field, with [6+] years of software or data engineering experience. 3+ years building LLM-based applications, including RAG, tool calling, or agents, with at least one solution in use by business users. Experience evaluating and testing LLM output quality. Hands-on Python coding at a production standard. Working knowledge of TypeScript/JavaScript and a modern web framework such as React. Strong SQL and experience working with enterprise data platforms. Hands-on experience with Azure (preferred) or AWS cloud services, API design, and CI/CD. Track record of working directly with business users to define and deliver solutions. Clear written and verbal communication with non-technical stakeholders. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Master’s degree in a technical field, or a finance/accounting background combined with engineering experience. Working knowledge of finance processes such as record-to-report, order-to-cash, procure-to-pay, or FP&A. Experience with SAP data structures, Snowflake (including Cortex), or the Azure AI stack (AI Foundry, AI Search, Document Intelligence, Azure ML). Experience with agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., Microsoft Agent Framework, LangGraph), MCP, and vector search. Exposure to ontologies, knowledge graphs, or rules engines. Experience in a regulated industry, with exposure to SOX or IT general controls. Relevant certifications (AWS or Azure Developer or Solutions Architect or other market leading runtimes). You don’t need every item on this list. If you’ve shipped AI that people use and you want to work close to the business, we want to hear from you. NON-STANDARD WORK SCHEDULE, TRAVEL, OR ENVIRONMENT REQUIREMENTS Regular overlap with US and European time zones is required, including some early-evening IST calls. Must be able to travel to Pfizer offices and partner sites when required, including occasional international travel. Work can be demanding at times, including support during period-end close or response to production incidents. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all. CNS (300) - Senior Consultant - Aera Technology At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence. We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world. About Global Delivery Services Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda. Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom. Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service. Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services. Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation. The Opportunity As an Aera Techno-Functional Senior, you will support the design, configuration, testing, and deployment of Decision Intelligence solutions. You will work with business stakeholders and technical teams to translate decision requirements into data, logic, user experience, and action-oriented solution components. Your Key Responsibilities Gather and document business processes, decision points, KPIs, pain points, data needs, and expected outcomes. Convert functional requirements into solution designs covering data preparation, curated data views, rules, recommendations, workflows, user screens, and actions. Use SQL to profile, reconcile, transform, and validate data across source and curated datasets. Configure and test Aera solution components under the guidance of solution leads and architects. Prepare test scenarios, execute unit and functional testing, support user acceptance testing, and resolve defects. Create clear functional and technical documentation, including mappings, logic, assumptions, test evidence, and operating guidance. Collaborate with client teams, data engineers, developers, and project managers to manage dependencies and delivery risks. Support production deployment, hypercare, issue triage, and continuous improvement of deployed solutions. Mentor junior team members and contribute reusable delivery assets and best practices. Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution. Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals. Skills And Attributes For Success Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, information systems, business analytics, supply chain, operations, finance, or a related field. Master’s degree or MBA from Tier 1 institute will be preferred. 5+ years of overall experience in technology consulting, analytics, enterprise applications, data solutions, or business process transformation. Strong SQL skills, including joins, aggregations, subqueries, data quality checks, and performance-aware query design. Ability to bridge business requirements and technical implementation in a techno-functional role. Experience with requirements gathering solution design, testing, documentation, and stakeholder communication. Understanding of data models, integrations, business rules, workflows, and enterprise application delivery. Ideally, you’ll also Prior hands-on Aera experience is a strong plus. Experience in Decision Intelligence, supply chain, planning, procurement, manufacturing, commercial, or finance use cases. Exposure to cloud data platforms, APIs, ETL/ELT, reporting, Python, or advanced analytics. Experience working in Agile or hybrid delivery models and distributed global teams. What We Look For Excellent verbal and written communication skills Ability to clearly articulate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. Strong ownership, accountability, and a delivery-focused mindset. Leadership presence and the ability to guide and mentor junior engineers. Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking. Collaborative team player who can also work independently with minimal supervision. What We Offer You At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today. To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need. Our Commitment : As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost. Professional Development : From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship. People and Culture : In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing. Benefits : Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development. How to Apply : If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy. Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits. “We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”. EY | Building a better working world EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets. Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate. Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Lead Data Scientist
description: Your role General - Data Analytics - P5 - IND What You'll Be Doing About the Role Corpay is seeking an experienced Lead Data Scientist to join the Risk Analytics team supporting Credit, Treasury, Liquidity, and Cash Management. Reporting to the Risk Analytics Lead, this is a senior individual contributor role responsible for delivering reliable operational reporting, data analysis, and automation that support business decision-making across these functions. The team is currently focused on streamlining data, strengthening report delivery, and building scalable analytics processes. Experience or interest in AI and model development is an added advantage, as these capabilities may become relevant as the reporting and data foundation matures over the coming years. Key Responsibilities Deliver and maintain complex business-as-usual (BAU) reports. Work independently while partnering closely with the Risk Analytics Lead and other team members to ensure high-quality, timely delivery of reporting and analysis. Partner with Credit, Treasury, Liquidity, Cash Management, Operations, and onshore stakeholders to understand evolving reporting needs and business challenges. Perform detailed analysis on large and varied datasets, ensuring data quality, reconciled outputs, and actionable insights. Support the integration and standardization of new data sources, and adapt reporting solutions to dynamic datasets and changing business requirements. Proactively identify process inefficiencies, data-quality gaps, and reporting risks, and propose control measures or automation solutions. Drive operational reporting, analysis, and automation enhancements using SQL, Python, Excel, and related data tools. Develop and refine dashboards, visualizations, and self-service reporting solutions when needed. Ensure timely communication, clear documentation, and alignment with global stakeholders. Qualifications & Skills 8-11 years of experience in data analytics, reporting, data engineering, or related roles, ideally supporting operational or financial functions. Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, Statistics, or a related field. Strong proficiency in SQL, Python, and Excel. Working knowledge of VBA, Power BI or other data-visualization tools, and AI-enabled analytics tools is an advantage. Exposure to machine learning or model development is desirable but not required. Demonstrated ability to operate as a senior individual contributor and collaborate effectively with cross-functional stakeholders. Familiarity with financial services, Credit, Treasury, Liquidity, Cash Management, or Risk reporting is preferred but not required. Strong communication, troubleshooting, and time management skills. Willingness to work in office, during the specified shift hours, is mandatory. Lead complex analyses, predictive models, and data-driven insights to influence strategic decisions Partner with leaders to define analytical questions and develop advanced models Improve data pipelines, modeling frameworks, and analytical processes Present insights and implications to leaders with clarity and structured narratives Develop analytics templates, standards, and automation opportunities Mentor analysts and contribute to capability-building efforts About Corpay About Corpay Corpay is a global technology organization that is leading the future of commercial payments with a culture of innovation that drives us to constantly create new and better ways to pay. description: When you join Verizon You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife. What you’ll be doing... Verizon is looking for a digital experience product owner to drive strategic initiatives to improve customer experience across wireless and wireline portals and unify digital experience for Verizon Business Group customers enabling digital traffic, sales, and self-serve growth. You will have a front row seat working with our business customers to understand their pain-points, partner with stakeholders across the business and lead cross functional teams to develop product visions, roadmaps, and MVPs and design, build, test and launch digital products. You will also partner with digital analytics to develop measurement frameworks and to define product key performance indicators and track performance and recommend enhancements on an ongoing basis. You must be an action oriented, results driven professional with a history of achievement operating in a fast paced environment. You Will Be Responsible For Conducting discovery to identify use cases for innovative features and enhancements aimed at optimising the digital customer journey. Pinpoint opportunities to drive digital sales growth and elevate CX through competitive benchmarking and capability gap analyses. Evaluating value and establishing priorities based on detailed data analyses of how new features and enhancements affect customers and business goals. Evaluating market needs and assessing new concepts for viability and commercial potential. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment with business goals. Develop SME level understanding of existing Verizon platforms and commerce flows in order to provide strategic recommendations for enhancements. Work closely with stakeholders across various internal teams to gather requirements and implement enhancements in coordination with UX, design, dev and QA teams. Participate in business case development and presentations for alignment with working Oversee legal approvals for new capabilities to guarantee all updates meet compliance standards. What We’re Looking For... Understanding what customers will want next is your driver. You are creative but balance that with your practical business side. You can juggle several projects with tight deadlines and not drop any balls—while also keeping your eye on the big picture. An environment with lots of competing priorities and new challenges every day is where you thrive. With a knack for working with different types of people, you inspire others to do their best work and carry out your vision. You Will Need To Have Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of relevant work experience Experience in product management E commerce or online experience Experience in improving customer experience Experience in enterprise digital analytics, with a strong preference for B2B industry experience AI skills required for pro-typing, writing user stories and other presentation skills Even better if you have one or more of the following: A degree or Master's degree. Data analytics and quantitative skills in user event data. Experience with product management and agile development including writing product backlog, epics, user stories, and grooming to support completion of initiatives. Knowledge of design thinking. Digital experience, digital marketing and digital product management either in a business, agency or consulting organisation. Lean Six Sigma Green or Black Belt Certification. If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above. Where you’ll be working In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes work from home and assigned office days set by your manager. Scheduled Weekly Hours 40 Equal Employment Opportunity Verizon is an equal opportunity employer.
